fusions.name: Folded Dart
fusions.desc: Flicks a folded dart that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Blunted] for 2 seconds with a 25% chance.

fusions.name: Flurry of Pages
fusions.desc: Looses 6 razor sheets at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Each hit also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Cut-Out Double
fusions.desc: Cuts out a double that stands for 12 seconds and strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds, each strike with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Errata
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
